from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/59743/1_59743_input.xlsx")

# Load workbook preserving formulas
wb = load_workbook(input_path, data_only=False)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Inspect relevant cells
print("Before:")
for r in range(3, 6):
    print(
        r,
        "F=", ws[f"F{r}"].value,
        "G=", ws[f"G{r}"].value,
        "J=", ws[f"J{r}"].value,
        "M=", ws[f"M{r}"].value,
    )

# Update only the requested answer cells G3:G5.
# Logic:
# - If M has a value, use F - M
# - Else if J has a value, use F - J
# - Else use F - 0, which displays F
# - If F is negative, preserve the original behavior of returning blank
for r in range(3, 6):
    ws[f"G{r}"] = f'=IF(F{r}>=0,F{r}-IF(M{r}<>"",M{r},IF(J{r}<>"",J{r},0)),"")'

# Encourage recalculation in Excel-compatible applications
try:
    wb.calculation.calcMode = "auto"
    wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
    wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
except Exception:
    pass

print("After:")
for r in range(3, 6):
    print(f"G{r} =", ws[f"G{r}"].value)

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

print(f"Saved to {output_path}")
